notes: Added missing API/interface, validation enforcement, and test coverage stories for FEAT-5.

FEAT-5-S146.title: Anthropic tool_use Block Parsing Contract
FEAT-5-S146.description: Define and implement the parsing contract for Anthropic tool_use blocks, normalizing tool name and input payload into a consistent internal structure prior to allowlist validation.

FEAT-5-S147.title: Pydantic Validation Enforcement Layer
FEAT-5-S147.description: Enforce strict Pydantic model validation for all allowlisted tools, including type coercion, required field enforcement, and standardized validation error propagation.

FEAT-5-S148.title: Tool Router Interface Exposure via FastAPI Entry Point
FEAT-5-S148.description: Integrate tool_router dispatch into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring tool execution is triggered correctly within the agent loop and responses are returned in API-compatible format.

FEAT-5-S149.title: Unit Tests for Allowlist Routing and Validation
FEAT-5-S149.description: Expand unit test coverage for tool_router to validate allowlist enforcement, correct handler dispatch, and Pydantic validation success and failure cases.

FEAT-5-S150.title: Integration Test with End-to-End Tool Execution Flow
FEAT-5-S150.description: Validate end-to-end execution from LLM tool_use output through tool_router dispatch to domain service execution, including successful and rejected tool scenarios.
